description: Mobile/accessibility polish and the README. Finalizes the phone-first experience and documents how to run the site and extend it by editing data only. Depends on FEAT-002 (the pages and components must exist).
steps: Accessibility + mobile polish pass across existing components/pages: confirm semantic landmarks (header/nav/main/footer), a working skip-to-content link, visible focus rings, tap targets >= 44px, no horizontal overflow at 360px width, and sufficient contrast for gold-on-ink and text. Adjust src/index.css and component classes as needed. Do not change the data or the information shown.

Create README.md at the workspace root covering: (1) what Ave Jesus Rex is (a Catholic apologetics resource; two live topics + coming-soon topics); (2) Run instructions: `npm install` then `npm run dev`; note it serves on port 5317; (3) Phone access: http://192.168.12.101:5317 — explain this is the dev machine's current LAN IP with the phone on the same wifi, and that `vite` also prints the live Network URL at startup; (4) Project structure overview; (5) The data model (Argument and Topic shapes, strength levels) summarized from src/data/types.ts; (6) 'How to add a new argument' — edit the relevant src/data/content/*.json, matching the Argument shape and using an existing category; (7) 'How to add a new topic' — add a TopicMeta entry in src/data/topics.ts, add a content JSON + typed re-export, flip status from 'coming-soon' to 'live', and wire loadContent.
Final full verification: run `npm install` from clean if needed, `npm run build`, and `npm run typecheck`. Ensure no dev/preview server is left running. Do NOT commit or run git.
acceptance_criteria: README.md exists at the root and documents run steps, the phone URL http://192.168.12.101:5317, the data model, and how to add arguments and topics.
`npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` both succeed.
Pages render without horizontal scrolling at a 360px mobile width and expose a skip-to-content link and visible focus states.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `npm run typecheck` and confirm it passes.
Confirm README.md contains the run commands, the phone URL, and the add-argument/add-topic instructions.
findings:
DONE. `npm run build` (tsc && vite build) and `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) both exit 0. Build emits dist/index.html + assets/index-*.css (~17.07kB, up from ~16.4kB due to added base styles) + assets/index-*.js (~256kB raw / ~83.7kB gzip). No server started/left running (dev-server smoke test skipped as in FEAT-002; environment blocks server starts). No git run. No data or displayed information changed.

ACCESSIBILITY + MOBILE POLISH (src/index.css + components): 
- Global :focus-visible rule in src/index.css adds a visible gold ring (ring-2 ring-gold-300 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-ink-900) to EVERY keyboard-focusable element — previously only the nav toggle, home cards, and skip link had explicit focus styling; inline links (back-to-home, all-topics) and the caveats <summary> had none. focus-visible keeps mouse clicks clean.
- Overflow guard: body { overflow-x: hidden } plus a base rule setting overflow-wrap:break-word on p/blockquote/cite/summary/li, and break-words on the large Greek/Hebrew OriginalLanguageBlock text, prevent horizontal scroll at 360px from long citations/original-language lines.
- Tap targets >=44px: standalone nav links (TopicPage header '← All topics', TopicPage not-found + coming-soon '← Back to home', NotFound '← Back to home') converted from inline-block text to inline-flex min-h-[44px] items-center with px-2; the 'Honest caveats' <summary> given flex min-h-[44px] items-center. (NavBar hamburger already h-11 w-11=44px; mobile menu links already py-3; home topic cards are full-card link targets.)
- Contrast: footer caveat line bumped text-parchment-500 -> text-parchment-400 for better legibility on ink-900.
- Semantic landmarks confirmed already present: <header> (NavBar), <nav aria-label='Primary'>, <main id='main-content'>, <footer> (Layout). Skip-to-content link targets #main-content which exists — working.

README.md written at workspace root. Covers: what Ave Jesus Rex is (Catholic apologetics; 2 live topics 'Jesus Is God' + "Jehovah's Witnesses", 4 coming-soon); run (npm install, npm run dev, port 5317, npm run build/preview); phone access http://192.168.12.101:5317 with note it's the dev machine's LAN IP (phone same wifi) and that vite prints the live Network URL; project structure; data model (Argument / TopicContent / TopicMeta shapes + 3 strength levels table) summarized from src/data/types.ts; step-by-step 'How to add a new argument' (edit src/data/content/*.json only, reuse an existing category) and 'How to add a new topic' (add content JSON + typed re-export, add/flip TopicMeta in src/data/topics.ts, wire loadContent, flip status to live) — both data-only, no route/component edits. Internal relative links to src files included.

No new dependencies. Theme tokens unchanged (reused ink/parchment/gold + Cormorant/Inter).
